methodology.sampling: Three independent extractions and compile calls per document; no response selection or fallback
methodology.attempts: One compile attempt and one transport attempt per run, including dev; interactive default is three
methodology.model_identity: Exact requested model alias; provider does not expose an immutable weight revision through this adapter
methodology.split: Kaiser/Highmark dev; other insurer SBCs held_out; previously measured holdouts are not freshly unseen
methodology.rules: Raw proposed rule_evidence entries versus retained validated rule paths; micro-averaged, not recall
methodology.quote_accuracy: Whitespace-normalized source containment; source-line citations are locally copied, not model-authored quotes
methodology.page_accuracy: No predicted page field. Physical offset locatability and limited labeled-field page overlap reported separately
methodology.claim_ready: Benefits present, no unresolved entries, all retained networks have explicit balance_billing
methodology.key_numbers: Manual pre-model labels; compare individual in-network limits and service copay/coinsurance pairs; missing and ambiguous count as misses
methodology.stability: Population variance of three retained counts, failures zero; limits must be present and identical in all three runs
methodology.latency: Monotonic wall time from worker start; includes extraction and compile/validation, excludes queue delay; provider timeout is per I/O, not a hard total deadline
methodology.privacy: No raw responses, quotes, policy text or free-form exceptions are saved
limitations: No all-rule gold inventory or service recall
No independent full condition/waiver or real-claim correctness assessment
Horizon tiered network excluded from single-network numeric score
Other policy documents have no numeric reference labels
Provider load from concurrent work is uncontrolled; timeout variance is not model-output nondeterminism
Concurrent compiler edits after import are not evaluated
